card.line: Thessalonica was a large Macedonian city with a Jewish synagogue, where Paul preached about Jesus, a church began, and trouble from opponents soon followed.

moments.title: Paul teaches in the synagogue
moments.text: On three Sabbaths Paul talked with the Jews from the Scriptures and showed that the Christ had to suffer and rise from the dead. Some Jews, many Greeks who worshiped God, and quite a few leading women joined Paul and Silas.

moments.title: A mob fills the city
moments.text: Jealous Jews gathered a mob and sent the city into an uproar. They raided Jason's house looking for Paul and Silas, then dragged Jason and other brothers before the city officials.

moments.title: Thessalonians chase Paul to Berea
moments.text: The Bereans were called more noble-minded than the Thessalonians. When the Jews from Thessalonica heard Paul was teaching in Berea, they went there to stir up the crowds.

moments.title: Gifts for Paul's needs
moments.text: Paul told the Philippians that while he was in Thessalonica, they gave him what he needed again and again.
